SpoolId.description: A lowercase hyphenated version 7 UUID identifying one registered spool.
SpoolId.title: SpoolId

description:
What a charge took from a spool, and the whole calculation behind it.

Present or absent as one: a debit names its spool exactly when it carries
the grams, the figures they were worked out with, and the spool's figure
either side of them.

density_g_cm3.description:
The density the grams were worked out with, in grams per cubic
centimetre.

diameter_mm.description: The diameter the grams were worked out with, in millimetres.

grams.description: What the length weighs, in grams; what is subtracted from the spool.

remaining_after_g.description: The spool's figure after it, in grams.

remaining_before_g.description: The spool's figure before the charge, in grams.
